extracted.intended_audience: BBC journalists, editors and other BBC content producers
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and standards BBC staff must follow when producing or publishing content across all BBC platforms; includes thematic guidance (privacy, language, emergencies), supplementary policy notes, training expectations and procedural guidance such as external linking and election guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial Guidelines applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: The Editorial Guidelines are the BBC's values and standards. They apply to all our content, wherever and however it is received.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This establishes that the Guidelines are authoritative for all BBC output and should be applied across genres and platforms. No further specifics on individual criteria are given on this page, but other linked sections and guidance notes expand on themes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy
rubrics_metrics.description: The BBC will respect privacy and will not infringe it without good reason, wherever in the world we are operating.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Privacy is a cross-cutting editorial obligation; infringement of privacy must be justified by a good reason. The page references meetings and further guidance on privacy and consent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial Policy Guidance Notes (supplementary)
rubrics_metrics.description: Editorial Policy Guidance Notes supplement the Editorial Guidelines, with further explanation of their themes and practical tips.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Producers should consult the Guidance Notes for practical application, examples and explanation of the high-level Guidelines. The Notes act as supplements rather than replacements of the main Guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: War, Terror and Emergencies guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Here’s a reminder of Guidelines on War, Terror and Emergencies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific thematic guidance exists for reporting on war, terror and emergencies; producers should follow the dedicated guidance when covering such events. The page points readers to that specific guidance rather than listing criteria here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of Language
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidelines on use of Language can be found here.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There are dedicated language-use rules (wording, tone, sensitive terminology) referenced by the Guidelines; content-makers should follow the linked language guidance for appropriate phrasing and avoidance of problematic terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Election and Referendum guidance (draft)
rubrics_metrics.description: Draft Election Guidelines for 2016 and EU Referendum Guidelines have just been launched.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Special rules apply during elections and referendums; the draft guidance indicates updated or additional constraints and procedures to ensure impartiality and compliance during political coverage. Producers should consult the election-specific guidance when relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training expectation (Editorial Standards training modules)
rubrics_metrics.description: There are 25 short, interactive Editorial Standards training modules on the BBC Academy website. Use your knowledge of the Editorial Guidelines to pick your way through a host of issues in real life scenarios.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Staff are expected to use available training (modules, masterclasses, quizzes) to hone editorial judgment. The training is presented as relevant to all genres and areas of expertise and helps apply the Guidelines in practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: External linking disclaimer / approach
rubrics_metrics.description: The BBC is not responsible for the content of external sites. Read about our approach to external linking.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When linking externally, BBC content should indicate that the BBC does not control external sites' content and follow the BBC's external linking policy. Producers should follow the linked policy for standards on linking and disclaimers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility (site-level signposting)
rubrics_metrics.description: Accessibility links / Accessibility Help are provided on the site.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site provides accessibility support for users; editorial teams should be aware of accessibility resources and likely ensure content is accessible (though specific accessibility criteria are not detailed on this page).
